component.name: Doom Launcher
component.summary: Doom frontend and WAD library for Linux

description.p: Doom Launcher is a library for Doom engine games and mods. On Linux it uses GTK 4 and libadwaita. It can detect GZDoom, UZDoom and other source ports as native binaries, AppImages, Flatpaks or snaps, import IWADs, and download mods from idgames, GitHub, Romero Games, and other community sites.

This is DoomedLauncherNix, a Linux-focused fork of Doom Launcher by Hobomaster22 (nstlaurent). The launcher and its Windows version are their work, shared under the GPL; this build adds the GTK 4 frontend and Flatpak packaging. Please support the original project.
Doom Launcher is an independent tool. It is not affiliated with or endorsed by id Software, and it ships no game data — you supply your own IWAD, or use a free one such as Freedoom.
